# Downstream mirror manifest
#
# A small subset of this repo is synced internally. Changing any file listed
# below requires a downstream sync.
#
# The mirror tracks the `opal-eol` branch, not `main`. A change only becomes
# eligible for sync once it has landed on that branch.
#
# Consumed by scripts/check-mirrored-files.js, which runs from the pre-push
# hook and from the Downstream Mirror Check GitHub workflow. Check a change
# locally with:
#
#   npm run check:mirror
#
#
# WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU CHANGE A MIRRORED FILE
#
#   1. Land the change on the `opal-eol` branch.
#   2. Put the literal token ACK_SYNC_REQUIRED somewhere in the PR
#      description. A PR touching a mirrored file fails CI until the token is
#      present — it acknowledges that the sync is needed, and it makes such
#      PRs easy to find later.
#   3. Flag the PR to a maintainer with downstream access so they can run the
#      import.
#   4. If you added or removed files, or changed imports or dependencies, say
#      so explicitly — those need hand edits downstream in the same change.
#
#
# This is an explicit file list, NOT a directory glob. Adding a new file next
# to a mirrored file does not mirror it.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line. Blank lines and `#` comments are
# ignored.

LICENSE
README.md

packages/types/src/canonical-endpoints.ts
